entities.summary: Jeremiah James Harty was an American prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as the 26th archbishop of the Archdiocese of Manila in the Philippines from 1903 to 1916. He later served as bishop of the Diocese of Omaha in Nebraska from 1916 until he died in 1927.
